copy.curiosityHook: Framed by thieves who pinched their bird suits, can two utterly mismatched city slickers survive life behind bars?
copy.description: Down on their luck in New York, pals Skip and Harry seek a fresh start out of town dressed as promotional woodpeckers, only to find themselves framed for a bank heist and shipped off to a maximum-security penitentiary.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, funny, and breezy, delivering an easy-watch buddy misadventure with steady comic momentum.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Sidney Poitier, this classic 1980 buddy comedy spins absurd mistaken identity and wrongful imprisonment into effortless, lighthearted laughs.

allowedMaterial: Skip and Harry leaving New York after hitting rock bottom
Landing promo gigs in woodpecker costumes
Their costumes being stolen and used in a bank robbery
Wrongful arrest and sentence to prison
Sidney Poitier direction and 1980 comedy context
excludedMaterial: Specific inmate relationships and plot twists
